subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: Require typed mutable-source ownership as a release precondition and refuse unowned retirement selections.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: Exclusive ownership is the safety boundary for destructive source retirement. FR-3, UB-3, and the Gate phase require missing ownership to stop publication before any deletion authority exists.
fit_criterion: Every eligible pilot source has one replayable active feature owner; missing, inactive, shared, inferred, and conflicting ownership fixtures publish zero authority.
